cat <<'EOF' > test_unicode_error.py
import requests
from requests.models import PreparedRequest

# Test different problematic URLs that might trigger UnicodeError
test_urls = [
    "http://.example.com",
    "http://..example.com", 
    "http://example..com",
    "http://.com",
    "http://.",
]

for url in test_urls:
    print(f"\nTesting URL: {url}")
    try:
        response = requests.get(url)
        print("  SUCCESS: Request completed")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  EXCEPTION: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
        
        # Also test direct URL preparation
        try:
            req = PreparedRequest()
            req.prepare_url(url, None)
            print("  URL preparation succeeded")
        except Exception as e2:
            print(f"  URL preparation failed: {type(e2).__name__}: {e2}")
EOF
